headline: Broadcom Shares Slide Amid Broader Technology Sector Pressures
summary: Shares of Broadcom experienced a downward slide amid broader technology sector pressures.
why: Semiconductor and hardware equities frequently correlate with broader technology sector sentiment and macroeconomic capital expenditure trends in tech infrastructure.

impacts.name: Broadcom Inc
impacts.why: Negative sector-wide momentum pulls down individual semiconductor stock prices.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Broad technology sell-offs and sector-wide sentiment deterioration exerted downward pressure on the stock price.
